# In Season

> A TRMNL recipe that displays seasonal fruit and vegetables for the current month in the United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia or New Zealand.

"In season" means domestic fresh harvest, not supermarket availability. The recipe uses a bundled country-and-month catalogue, not live crop or weather data.

## Project reference

- [In Season reference](https://oneill9.github.io/trmnl-in-season/llms.md): Setup, supported countries, harvest rules and limitations in Markdown.
- [Sources and methodology](https://oneill9.github.io/trmnl-in-season/): Public guide to the evidence for each country.
- [Data sources](https://oneill9.github.io/trmnl-in-season/DATA_SOURCES.md): Evidence links and catalogue inclusion rules in Markdown.
- [Install the TRMNL recipe](https://trmnl.com/recipes/407471): Published recipe for a TRMNL device.

## Optional

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oneill9/trmnl-in-season/main/README.md): Project setup and development notes.
- [Catalogue and transform](https://github.com/oneill9/trmnl-in-season/blob/main/src/transform.js): Country-specific produce, harvest months and selection logic.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/oneill9/trmnl-in-season): Templates, tests and issue tracker.
